title: A/P Detail: a vendor credit line is negative and self-dated
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has an unused $25.00 vendor credit created 10 days ago.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Open "1-30 days past due".
  4. Find the vendor credit.
  5. Read its Due Date.
  6. Read its Past Due.
  7. Read its two money columns (Amount, Open Balance).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • the credit's own date.

Step 6:

  • 10.

Step 7:

  • $-25.00 and $-25.00.

Why this matters: Vendor credits must read as money in the shop's favour.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingDetailFetcher.php:103-131; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Application/AccountPayable/AgingDetail/ApAgingDetailQueryHandler.php:31-34. V1 code, quoted: `'vc.date_created AS dueDate', 'GREATEST(1, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, vc.date_created, :asOfDate)) AS pastDue'`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-136) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
